dossier.title: Migrated auth from Okta to Clerk
dossier.subtitle: Replaced Okta SAML with Clerk OAuth for reduced vendor lock-in and 40% cost savings.

pages.title: Overview
pages.summary: Why we migrated and what changed.

blocks.text: We moved from Okta's SAML-based authentication to Clerk's OAuth provider. The change reduces vendor lock-in, cuts auth costs by 40%, and gives our users a faster login flow.

left.label: Okta SAML
left.value:
Setup: 3 weeks
Timeout: 1 hour
MFA: via Okta rules
Cost: $0.08 per user

right.label: Clerk OAuth
right.value:
Setup: 2 days
Timeout: up to 30 days
MFA: TOTP or passkeys
Cost: $0.048 per user

pages.title: Rollback plan
pages.summary: How to revert if we hit a blocker.

blocks.text: The Okta configuration remains active in production until we ship Clerk to 100% of users. If we hit a critical bug, we can roll back in two steps.

items.title: Flip the environment variable AUTH_PROVIDER to 'okta' and deploy
Drain Clerk sessions (users will be asked to login again)

blocks.text: Rollback can happen without user downtime if done within 24 hours. After that, Okta sessions will have expired.
We used a gradual rollout: 10% of users on day 1, 50% on day 2, 100% on day 3. At each step we monitored error rates, login latency, and session failures.
